note: An order that is neither `oldestFirst` nor `newestFirst`. The two orders are a closed set, passed through to the host as they are.
`order` as a boolean. It names an order, `oldestFirst` or `newestFirst`; a flag cannot say which way `true` points.
`maxPages` of zero. A browse that may read no page lists nothing and could only answer `complete: false`; the least is one page.
`beforeVersion` of 0. The bound is exclusive and versions start at 1, so 0 selects nothing; a surface that sends it has lost its place, and an empty answer would read as a room with nothing older.
A null nextCursor. A listing read to its end omits nextCursor; it is never null.
